scope: Successful generation run only; earlier failed requests are separate.
limits: Ledger charges are authoritative; retained reservations are not confirmed API cost.
Application cache hits send no request; confirmed cached_tokens are separate provider-side input-cache usage.
Attempt artifact counts include pre-request failures; matching ledger entries retain failed or unknown requests.
ASR timings cover saved successful reports; failed/interrupted inference time may be unmeasured.
Inference seconds exclude lock wait but include import/call and post-call report preparation; processing seconds include broader chunk work.
Publication timings do not measure browser rendering or human comprehension.
Codex/development-assistant usage, electricity and model download time are not measured here.
The 15 uncertain recognized lines were excluded from translation. Eligible-line coverage is not complete spoken-content coverage.
No human comprehension, semantic accuracy, or whole-audio listening score is established by this run.
